caption:
Buying more bins won't fix a cabinet where the back six inches are functionally gone.

Clear containers, stackable trays, labels on every lid — the containers were never the problem. The problem is a cabinet that only lets you reach the front six inches.

The Simple Houseware 2-Tier Sliding Basket Organizer fixes the mechanism instead of the containers. Chrome wire, two tiers, and the front basket slides out on its own track so the back tier stays reachable.

Whatever's stored behind the front basket stays visible instead of disappearing into the cabinet. $34.97.
